notes: «قالا حدثنا حماد بن سلمة» (after هارون بن حيان and عبد العزيز بن المغيرة) is written once after the last «ح»: the tail, shared by all three branches; the first branch's «حدثنا حماد بن سلمة» is the same teacher and is carried by the tail.
Archive chronology flags (a name who died before the next transmitter was born) are not decided here: the chain cannot tell which name is wrong.
«قال فكان الأشعث بن قيس يقول ...» is a later remark, not a link.
